ui_bugs.issue: Hero column still overflows viewport by 17px on iPhone 13 Pro: document.body.scrollWidth=407 vs window.innerWidth=390. All hero children (badge, H1 spans STRATEGIC/THERMAL/RECONNAISSANCE, paragraph, CTA wrapper, both CTAs, stats grid, hud-card image wrapper) measure left=16 right=401 width=385 — i.e. their containing column is wider than the viewport. The H1 fix (text-[2rem] + break-words) made the H1 *content* fit inside its 385px box, but the box itself is positioned x=[16,401] which exceeds 390. The visual symptom in the screenshot is the right edge of 'RECONNAISSANCE' clipping past the right side of the screen, and a horizontal scrollbar appearing. Root cause: the .grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 container or its parent .container/max-w wrapper appears to compute a column width of 385px starting at x=16, which equals viewport_width(390) - left_padding(16) + right_overflow(11) — the right padding is being lost. Check `/app/frontend/src/pages/Landing.jsx` line ~24 (grid wrapper) and any parent in App layout / index.css for missing `box-sizing: border-box` or width:100vw without compensating padding, or for a fixed min-width breaking the layout.

action_items: [HIGH] Fix remaining 17px horizontal overflow on Landing at 390px. The H1+CTA fixes were necessary but not sufficient — the parent hero column itself measures 385px wide positioned at x=16, ending at x=401 (11-17px past viewport). Either (a) add `overflow-x: hidden` on the page root, (b) replace any `w-screen` with `w-full`, or (c) wrap the hero section with a container that uses `max-w-[100vw] px-4 mx-auto` and ensure no descendant uses fixed width / min-width that breaks the column.
[LOW] Consider also tightening tracking on H1 for sub-360px viewports (`tracking-[0.02em]`) so 'RECONNAISSANCE' has more breathing room once the parent overflow is fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: Iteration-5 fix only patched the *visible content* of the hero (H1 size + CTA stacking) but didn't address the actual *layout container* overflow. The H1 is now wrapping correctly internally, yet body.scrollWidth still equals 407, proving the overflow originates from a parent wrapper, not the H1. Recommend adding a CI guard `expect(document.body.scrollWidth).toBeLessThanOrEqual(window.innerWidth + 2)` on every route at 390px before declaring mobile responsive.

Note for E1: the Made-with-Emergent badge overlay covers the bottom-right corner of the sticky wizard action bar on mobile, intercepting real Playwright click events on `wizard-next-btn` and `authorize-launch-btn` (had to use JS .click() to advance steps in tests). For end-users this is non-blocking because the badge is in the iframe overlay and clicks pass through, but consider raising the sticky bar's z-index or adding bottom padding so the button is not visually hidden behind the Emergent badge on iPhone.
